projects.title: Hotel
projects.text: A hotel inspired by the palm tree and the ancient Ziggurat of Ur. The building rises in shifted levels and stepped terraces, with palm-shaped columns carrying the base and a long colonnade leading guests in.
facts: Palm tree and the Ziggurat of Ur

projects.title: The Riverline Complex
projects.text: Modern apartments arranged for light, ventilation, privacy, and community, with a view of the river and its gardens. White towers are linked by lattice pedestrian bridges that turn circulation into a promenade.

projects.title: Hope Hospital
projects.text: A pediatric hospital planned as a calm place for children and their families. Courtyards and daylight soften the clinical program, and a clear circulation keeps public rooms apart from treatment areas.

projects.title: Home Interior
projects.text: A modern minimalist house interior. Contemporary in tone, with focus lighting, shelf lighting, and one open volume for living, dining, and the kitchen.

projects.title: Traditional Fashion House
projects.lines: Four acts in one building: learning, creating, exhibiting, and selling.
projects.text: Graduation project at Catholic University in Erbil, sited in Duhok. The programme follows four acts, learning, creating, exhibiting, and selling, and the board carries the site analysis, sections, elevations, and renders.

projects.title: Landscape
projects.lines: Ten hectares that move from a modern edge, through a palm grove, into a heritage garden.
projects.text: A landscape of ten hectares. The sequence moves from a modern entrance, through palm planting, to a heritage garden, so the visitor walks from the present toward the region's past.

projects.title: Business Center
projects.lines: A glass office block under an angular canopy, modelled in Revit.
projects.text: A business center with a glass envelope and an angular canopy marking the entrance. Modelled in Revit as an early study of structure and skin.
